tank_description: A Well armoured close range SPAA brawler, hosting two 35mm cannons and a range of missiles for numerous scenarios. Well suited to ambushing flankers and taking down enemy air support.

strengths.title: Anti Air
strengths.description: The AGDS is designed to counter aircraft and as such has excellent gun elevation. Alongside this it also has access to surface-to-air missiles which lock on to enemy aircraft.

strengths.title: ATGMs
strengths.description: This vehicle has access to six ATGMs to help deal with vehicles at longer distances, note they have a firing arch and cannon hit targets at close ranges.

strengths.title: Turret Traverse
strengths.description: Has one of the highest turret traverses in the game allowing it to engage targets quickly and effectively.

strengths.title: Damage Per Minute
strengths.description: The AGDS has one of the highest damage per minutes of any vehicle as long as it is in a position to do so without overheating.

strengths.title: Armour
strengths.description: Based on the hull of an abrams the agds naturally has good hull armour. The turret front has reasonable armour in a lot of areas but not all.

weaknesses.title: Ammorack Modules
weaknesses.description: This vehicle has a frontal ammorack which can be hit by most vehicles due to the area not having much armour. It also has ammorack modules on the side of the turret which are exceptionally easy to hit when the turret is traversed.

weaknesses.title: Mobility
weaknesses.description: The AGDS isn't particularly slow in terms of top speed but the combination of mediocre acceleration and bad traverse, maneuvering in close quarters can feel very sluggish.

weaknesses.title: Cannon Range
weaknesses.description: This vehicle has high falloff and is unable to deal with threats past 100m effectively without the use of ATGMs.

weaknesses.title: Overheat Mechanic
weaknesses.description: The AGDS can shoot a vast amount of shots before overheating but upon overheat it is basically out of the fight for the next twenty seconds or so.

tank_summary: The AGDS is a close range nightmare and is somewhat a lurking assassin. Due to its reasonable armour layout and high damage per minute it can quickly take out vehicles when it catches their flank. It provides a lot of utility to a team with its anti-air capabilities, ATGMs and because of the capabilities of the surface-to-air missiles locking onto ground targets it can immobilise and destroy shields relatively effectively.
